question: Should runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain reserved for sandbox containers with runtime docs updated accordingly?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice changes user-facing container setup behavior, Podman/Docker parity, and sandbox path semantics.

options.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, generated setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind Docker sandbox path work
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker workspace path contract first, then apply one policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, generated setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent history across Docker setup, container docs, and release-era container path behavior.
